title: CORE-7002 · B-Corp banner gap — real, but homepage-only and 40px below 1023
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7002](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7002) · **PR** #115

Premise confirmed; **two things in the ticket are wrong.**

## Not SHARED — homepage only

All **104** pages from the clone's sitemap were fetched and grepped: the block renders on exactly **one**, `/`.
Live agrees — other live pages contain `bcorpBanner` once, but that occurrence is the CSS rule in the shared
inlined stylesheet, not markup. The homepage has 8 occurrences; `/blog/` has 0. **Suggest re-titling to Homepage.**

## Below 1023px it is 40px, not 20

Banner bottom edge → top of the next painted text:

| width | live | clone before | delta | after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 360 / 500 / 767 | 110 | 70 | **-40** | **110** |
| 768 / 1000 / 1022 | 180 | 140 | **-40** | **180** |
| 1023 / 1024 / 1440 / 1590 / 1800 | 160 | 140 | -20 | **160** |

The gap **above** the banner was also wrong, which the ticket does not mention — same 20px, at >=1023 only
(live 160 vs clone 140; 70 and 140 already matched below that). Fixed too.

## Cause

The banner's own margin was never at fault: live `margin-bottom` is 70px below 768 and 140px at >=768,
which `mb-[70px] md:mb-[140px]` already matches exactly, breakpoint included.

The missing pixels are live's **page-body wrapper**. Live renders the banner as a direct child of
`Layouts--app`, *outside* the wrapper, so `div.Wrapper--wrapper__content`'s own padding lands either side:
`padding-top: 40px` (<1023) / `20px` (>=1023), `padding-bottom: 20px` (>=1023 only). Live's totals are the
sum: 70+40=110, 140+40=180, 140+20=160. The clone has no wrapper split — every section is a plain sibling —
so that padding had nowhere to come from.

Breakpoints verified by sweeping live at 17 widths (360/500/600/700/760/**767/768**/800/900/1000/**1022/1023**/1024/1100/1440/1590/1800):
margin switches at **768** (Tailwind `md:`), wrapper padding at **1023** (the repo's `min-[1023px]` convention).
No new breakpoint introduced.

## The change

One line in `BCorpCertification.styles.ts`:
`section: 'w-full'` -> `section: 'w-full pb-[40px] min-[1023px]:pt-[20px] min-[1023px]:pb-[20px]'`

**Padding, not margin, deliberately.** `margin-bottom` would collapse with the banner's own `mb` to
`max(140, 40) = 140`; `margin-top` would collapse with the previous section's `mb-[140px]` to `max(140, 20) = 140`.
Padding never collapses, so it is additive — which is what live sums to. (This repo already shipped one
no-op `mb-[15px]` fix for exactly this reason.)

`SectionWrapper` composes with `cn()` = `twMerge(clsx())` and `className` is last, so these override the CMS
`paddingBottom: 'none'` -> `pb-0` cleanly rather than racing it on class order.

**No colour change:** the gap band is `rgb(255,255,255)` on live, and `--surface-canvas-inverse` is
`rgb(255 255 255)` for RF, verified by hit-testing the gap midpoint on both sites.
acceptanceCriteria: Gap below the banner is 110 / 180 / 160 at the same widths live is.
Gap above the banner is 160 at >=1023, matching live; unchanged below.
Breakpoints land on 768 and 1023, the repo's existing conventions.
Ticket re-scoped off SHARED to homepage-only in Linear.
